recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add display subelements or designation.isPrimary for FHIR-15736 unless a future work-group decision reopens that model change.
issue_request: FHIR-15736 was Published/Not Persuasive with Modification. It requested language/use/value support for the primary display in ValueSet.compose.include.concept, either by changing display into a designation-like backbone element or by adding designation.isPrimary. The accepted resolution rejected those structural alternatives and said documentation of display, designations, and Resource.language covers the issue.
initial_application: Git commit 670fde290b18eb77285b22912615dc941c139afa applied GF#15736 by adding ValueSet Display and Designations narrative explaining display as a special designation with Resource Language. Later source movement preserved the guidance.
additional_context: FHIR-18575 later corrected the same ValueSet designation wording to primary designation and is already represented on the combined branch by c67067b7a2f4cca5a7925b711cd79a57e38066b5. The current ValueSet narrative and StructureDefinition source use that wording, and ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already follows the accepted documentation approach: display remains a string, designations carry alternate language/purpose representations, and the current narrative and element comments explain display as the primary designation in the resource language.
